title: Settings
closeTipHint: Everything here applies as you change it — there is nothing to save.

appearance.heading: Theme
appearance.hint: Dark is the design target for video work; light is fully supported.
appearance.tipSystem: Follows your operating system, and changes with it.
appearance.tipDark: The design target — panels recede so footage reads true.
appearance.tipLight: Fully supported; easier in a bright room.

notify.heading: Tell me when a render finishes
notify.hint: A desktop notification when the queue empties — only while LocalCut AI is in the background.
notify.tipOn: Raise a desktop notification when the last render in the queue finishes. Never while you are looking at the app.
notify.tipOff: Never notify. The taskbar still shows how far along a render is.

zoom.heading: Interface zoom
zoom.hint: Scales the whole interface on top of your system text size. Ctrl + and Ctrl − work anywhere; Ctrl 0 resets.
zoom.tipHint: {pct} of normal size. Ctrl + and Ctrl − do this from anywhere.

language.heading: Language
language.hint: The language of the app's interface.
language.tipHint: Changes the interface only — it does not translate your projects.

defaults.hint: Starting values for new videos — every field can still be changed per video.
defaults.formatHint: The same controls as Home's prompt row. What you set here is where every new video starts; changing them on Home applies to that video only.
defaults.voiceHint: Narrator used when a video doesn't specify one.
defaults.modelHint: Used when you create the final video. "Auto" follows the hardware recommendation; custom models appear here once added.
defaults.aspectTipHint: What new videos start as. Home's row still decides each video.
defaults.durationTipHint: What new videos start as. Home's row still decides each video.
defaults.modelTipHint: Renders the finished video when a scene names no model of its own.

providers.heading: Cloud providers
providers.hint: Bring your own keys: they live in your OS keychain, go only to your engine, and are never sent to us.
providers.noKeychain: No OS keychain available — keys are stored obfuscated only.
providers.saveTipHint: Goes to your OS keychain and to your own engine. Never to us.
providers.clearTipHint: Deletes it from the keychain here. Nothing changes at the provider.

models.heading: Model library
models.hint: Download more local models any time — jobs pick them up immediately.
models.defaultsHint: What renders each kind of work when a scene doesn't name a model.

storage.hint: Everything LocalCut AI keeps on this machine. Projects and models can be removed here.
storage.stale: Couldn't refresh just now — showing the last loaded sizes.
storage.deleteTipHint: Deletes this project and every file in it. Asks first.
storage.clearCacheTipHint: Intermediate render files only — nothing you made is removed.
storage.clearToolsTipHint: One-off outputs made without a project. Your videos are untouched.
storage.manageModelsTipHint: Opens the Models section, where weights are downloaded and removed.
storage.cacheHint: Safe to clear — anything needed is regenerated on demand.
storage.clearCacheMessage: Removes regenerable intermediate files from every project. Nothing you made is lost — the next render rebuilds what it needs.
storage.toolsHint: Scripts, images, voiceovers and clips made without a project. They are kept until you remove them.
storage.clearToolsMessage: Removes every quick tool output and the files they generated, stopping anything still generating. Your projects are untouched. This can't be undone.
storage.modelsHint: Downloaded model weights are managed in the model library.
storage.failed: Could not measure disk usage — the engine did not answer. Reopen this tab to try again.
storage.clearCacheFailed: Could not clear the cache — the engine did not answer. Nothing was removed; try again.

remote.heading: Remote engine
remote.hintAfter: on a GPU box, then paste its pairing code here — this laptop becomes the remote control. Projects and renders live with the engine.
remote.pairedUnreachable: Paired with a remote engine (currently unreachable)
remote.allRemote: All generation runs on the remote engine.
remote.disconnectHint: Disconnect to fall back to the local engine.
remote.disconnectTipHint: Falls back to the engine on this machine. Nothing on the remote is deleted.
remote.armTipHint: Sends the stored keys over the pinned connection, held in memory only.
remote.cancelTipHint: Nothing has been sent to this host yet.
remote.confirmTipHint: Trusts this host and pins the certificate shown above.
remote.pairTipHint: Decodes the code and shows you the host before anything is sent.
remote.armHeading: Provider keys are not shared with this engine
remote.armHint: Cloud generation runs on the engine, so it needs your keys ({keys}) to reach those providers. They are sent over the pinned connection and held in memory only.
remote.armed: Your provider keys are shared with this engine.
remote.reviewVerify: Check this matches what the other machine printed before you continue. Anyone who gives you a pairing code chooses the address it connects to.
remote.reviewArmKeys: Also send my provider keys ({keys}) to {host}

engine.heading: This engine
engine.hint: The connection and hardware of the engine rendering your projects.
engine.urlInfo: The local address the app uses to talk to the render engine
engine.backendInfo: The renderer chain the engine tries in order — the first match serves each task
engine.hardwareInfo: Detected GPU and performance tier — this drives model recommendations

backends.heading: Task routing
backends.hintAuto: What renders each step of your video. Routing is automatic: a step runs on a generative backend only while a model for it is installed.
backends.hintManual: What renders each step of your video. Routing is pinned by LOCALCUT_COMFY_KINDS; delete that variable to route from installed models.
backends.unrouted: no backend — this step cannot render
backends.noFfmpeg: Assembly and export need FFmpeg, and none was found on this machine. Install FFmpeg and restart LocalCut AI — until then these steps will fail rather than produce a placeholder video.
backends.stillClips: {name} — still images with motion applied; install a video model for true motion

kindInfo.script: Writes the screenplay — your idea becomes narrated scenes
kindInfo.keyframe: Generates the still image that defines each scene's look
kindInfo.thumbnail: Small preview images for scene tiles and project cards
kindInfo.clip: Animates each scene's keyframe into a moving video clip
kindInfo.narration: Speaks the story aloud with text-to-speech
kindInfo.captions: Times the spoken words for subtitles
kindInfo.timeline: Cuts clips, narration, captions and music into one edit

backends.noDrawtext: This machine's FFmpeg cannot draw text, so on-screen titles will not be burned into the video. Everything else renders normally. Installing an FFmpeg build with libharfbuzz (most distribution packages have it) restores titles.

setup.heading: Setup
setup.hint: Run the first-launch hardware check and recommended model picks again.
setup.tipHint: Re-runs the hardware check. Nothing you have made is changed.

about.hint: Version, updates, diagnostics — and what this app does (and doesn't) send anywhere.
about.copyTipHint: App and engine versions, backend and hardware — as text on your clipboard.
about.licensesTipHint: Every bundled package, its version and its license.
about.licensesIntro: LocalCut AI is built with these open-source packages. Each remains under its own license, held by its respective authors.
about.dataFolderUnknown: this engine does not report its folder
about.checkUpdatesTipHint: Asks GitHub for the latest release. Nothing downloads on its own.
about.checkedAt: Checked {when} — updates download only when you ask.
about.neverChecked: Never checked — updates download only when you ask.
about.supportHint: The bundle holds this app's logs, its versions and the system report. Nothing is sent anywhere — you choose where to save it.
about.openLogsTipHint: Opens the folder holding this app's and the engine's logs.
about.shortcutsTipHint: The full keyboard map, over whatever you are looking at.
about.privacyBody: LocalCut AI reaches the network for exactly two things: model downloads, and the update check you trigger. No telemetry, no accounts, no usage data — your prompts and media never leave this machine.
about.fine: © {year} · Built on open models — each one's license is shown where you download it.

workflows.hint: Custom ComfyUI graphs, and the third-party node packs they need. Only relevant if you run ComfyUI — everything ships working without any of this.
workflows.packsHint: A pack is third-party code. Enabling one lets it run on this machine; nothing here installs anything, it records that you allow what you already installed.
workflows.noPacks: This engine's catalog lists no node packs.
workflows.enableTipHint: asks you to confirm the version first — nothing runs yet
workflows.disableTipHint: the code stays installed; the engine stops loading it
workflows.enableConfirmTip: Grant this pack permission to run
workflows.enableConfirmTipHint: pinned to the version above; updating it asks again
workflows.versionHint: The version you installed in ComfyUI. The grant is pinned to it, so updating the pack asks you again.
workflows.acknowledge: I installed this pack myself, I trust its source, and I understand it runs unsandboxed.
workflows.filesHint: Exported ComfyUI graphs (Save (API Format)). Each is checked against the packs you have enabled before it is stored.
workflows.importTipHint: checked against your enabled packs before it is stored
workflows.noSlots: no prompt slots — renders the same output every time
workflows.removeTipHint: deletes the file from the engine's workflow folder
workflows.removeMessage: The file is deleted from this engine's workflow folder. Any custom model pointing at it will stop rendering until you import it again.
